faixa.aviso: Nobody finds out you watched. Gone in 24 h.
faixa.entrar: Sign in to see and create stories.

criar.descartar: Close without posting? What you made here will be lost.
criar.limiteDeFigurinhas: That's 3. Remove one to add another.

publicoAjuda.proximos: Only your trusted circle (the list only you can see).
publicoAjuda.comunidade: Only members of the community you choose.

criar.regra: Gone in 24 h. Doesn't go to the Fediverse. Nobody sees who watched.
criar.alt: Describe the image for people who can't see it (optional)
criar.semMetadado: The image is redrawn on your device: it leaves without location or camera data.
criar.vazio: Write some text, draw, take a photo or choose from the gallery.
criar.deUmPost: Story from a post: the link to the post goes along.

erro.grande: Image too large (up to 3 MB once ready).
erro.invalida: Couldn't read this image. Use JPG, PNG or WEBP.
erro.link: The link must start with https:// and have a valid address.
erro.ato: Pick an action for the countdown.
erro.enquete: Write the question and both poll options.
erro.dadoPessoal: It looks like there's personal data (phone, ID number, email or address). Remove it before posting.
erro.limite: You've posted many stories just now. Wait a bit.
erro.banco: The database doesn't have stories yet (the server update is missing).

midia.somAjuda: With sound off, the audio never leaves your device.
midia.gestos: Drag to move. With two fingers (or the mouse wheel), rotate and zoom.
midia.semMetadadoVideo: The video is rebuilt on your device at 720p: no location and no camera data.
midia.altVideo: Describe the video for people who can't see it (optional)

progresso.preparando: Preparing the video on your device… {pct}%
progresso.ajuda: The video is rebuilt here, without location. Keep this screen open.
progresso.ajudaFoto: The photo is rebuilt here, without location. Keep this screen open.

erroMidia.video: Couldn't read that video. Use MP4, MOV or WEBM.
erroMidia.videoGrande: The video got too large (max 20 MB). Trim a shorter clip.
erroMidia.semGravador: This browser can't rebuild videos. Use a photo or another browser.
erroMidia.cancelado: Upload cancelled. Nothing left your device.

criar.figurinhaDica: Drag to move; with two fingers, rotate and resize. Keyboard: arrows move, + and − resize, [ and ] rotate.

contagem.semAtos: You have no action scheduled. Call an action to use the countdown.
contagem.avisar: Let me know when it starts
contagem.avisado: We'll let you know when it starts

enquete.notaAutora: Only you see the total. Voters' names don't appear.
enquete.nota: Only {nome} sees the total. Your name doesn't appear.
enquete.votou: Vote sent only to the total.
enquete.poucas: Few people have voted yet: the total shows from 3 on.

comunidade.nenhuma: You're not in any community yet.

visor.ajuda: Arrows to switch stories, space to pause, Esc to close.
visor.silenciar: Don't show {nome}'s stories on this device
visor.silenciado: You won't see {nome}'s stories on this device anymore. Nobody finds out.
visor.denunciaAjuda: Whoever reports is never revealed. Threats, doxxing and risk to children take the story down right away, until moderators look.
visor.apagarConfirma: Delete now? It's gone for everyone, with the replies.
visor.respostasChegam: Replies and reactions reach only you, in your notifications.

categorias.autolesao: Self-harm or risk to life (urgent: in Brazil call 188, CVV)

visor.ajudaToque: Touch: right side goes forward, left goes back, hold to pause, swipe sideways to change person and down to close. M key toggles sound.
visor.semSomNoVideo: This video was posted without sound

cartao.porNoStoryAjuda: Creates a story with this post's link (gone in 24 h)

previa: Preview with sample data: nothing here is sent.

camera.dica: Tap for photo, hold for video
camera.negada: No permission for the camera. Allow it in your browser settings, or use the gallery.
camera.semCamera: No camera found on this device. Use the gallery.
camera.privacidade: Nothing leaves your device until you publish.

destaques.aviso: It stays on your profile after 24 h, for the same audience as now. Remove it whenever you want. Never goes to the Fediverse.
destaques.apagarConfirma: Delete the highlight {titulo}? Its stories older than 24 h will disappear.
destaques.vazioDono: No highlights yet. On your story, tap ⋯ and "Save to highlight".

pagina.lede: Stories from people you follow and from your communities. Tap a circle to watch, or “Your story” to make yours.

arrumar.ajuda: This order shows on your profile. Use the arrows or buttons to change it.
arrumar.vazio: You have no highlights yet. Keep a story in a highlight and it will show up here.
arrumar.erroCarregar: Could not load. Close and try again.
arrumar.semFoto: No photo: the cover uses the color.

borrar.pergunta: This photo will stay on your profile after 24 h. Is there a face of someone who does not want to be seen?
borrar.refazendo: Redoing the photo on this device…
borrar.erro: Could not redo the photo. It was not saved.
borrar.noCriarAjuda: Protect people at the action (LGPD art. 11: political opinion is sensitive data).
borrar.videoAjuda: Mark the faces on this frame. The blur stays in the same place for the whole video: check the preview.

post.indisponivel: This post is no longer available.
post.vaiJunto: Goes with the story: the post card, with a link to it.
post.soCidade: The story shows only the city, never the meeting point.

visor.reacoesPoucas: Few reactions: the total shows from 3.

respostas.ajuda: Whoever replied chose to talk only to you. If you publish a reply, the sender's name does not go with it.
respostas.caixaVazia: When someone replies to one of your stories, it shows here.

vou.ajuda: Tapping confirms attendance, like on the action page. Nobody sees who goes.

pessoa.ajuda: They get a notice. Someone who blocked you cannot be mentioned.

campanha.ajuda: Only plain letters, numbers and _ (2 to 40).

decorativas.ajuda: Up to 3 per story. Drawn here, nothing downloaded from outside.

roda.ajuda: Only you see this list. Nobody is told when they join or leave, and nobody knows whose circles they are in.
roda.vazia: Your circle is empty: a circle story reaches no one.
roda.naoAchada: We could not find that @ (or there is a block).

comunidade.nenhuma: You are not a member of any community yet.

legendas.ajuda: Write what is said. With the sound off, the caption is what people read.
legendas.gerarAjuda: Recognizes speech right here, without sending the audio out. Check each part.
legendas.semGerar: This browser cannot recognize speech without sending the audio out: write the captions.
legendas.falta: Check the generated captions before publishing.
legendas.nenhumaFala: We found no speech in the video.

musica.ajuda: Made right here on the device. Nothing is downloaded and nobody learns what you listened to.

recortar.moldura: Crop frame. Arrows move it; Shift with arrows resizes it.

desenho.borrachaAjuda: Drag over a stroke to erase it.

sequencia.ajuda: Up to 10 photos or videos: each becomes a story, in order.
sequencia.partes: {s} s video: goes as {n} stories of up to 60 s.

ato.ajuda: Creates a story with this action's card (date and city; gone in 24 h)
